Body:
Adds one line under `## Releated Tools`, after the 0xArchive entry.

BTC500 is a free dashboard for the Bitcoin 500-day rule (buy 500 days before the halving, sell 500 days after). For every completed window it publishes the entry and exit date, the multiple, the lowest close against the entry (worst: -83.65%, 2012) and the days from entry to the low. The same numbers are served as JSON and the daily BTC/USD close history as CSV, so they can be quoted or charted.

- [BTC500](https://btc500.net/bitcoin-500-day-cycle) - Free 500-day halving-cycle dashboard: entry and exit for every completed window, post-entry drawdown (worst -83.65%), and the live buy date, plus daily BTC/USD closes as CSV and JSON. No signup, no ads.

No tracking, no affiliate links.
